text:
Priya: Heads up — main CI turned red on mypy after the serializer refactor. Failing file: runtime/kv_cache.py. Looks like mypy is now complaining about Optional[bytes] being used where we expect a Mapping. Anyone oncall to triage?
Alex: Can you paste the exact mypy error?
Priya: Sure, here’s the tail of the output:
```
runtime/kv_cache.py:128: error: Argument 1 to "update" of "dict" has incompatible type "Optional[Mapping[str, Any]]"; expected "Mapping[str, Any]"  [arg-type]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 250 source files)
```
Dan: That smells like the serializer change from yesterday (PR #4321) — it started returning Optional[Mapping] when deserializing empty payloads.
Jamie: FYI pyproject has stricter mypy config now (disallow-incomplete-defs-ish), so previously permissive code is getting caught. Two quick paths: update kv_cache to handle None, or change serializer to never return None. Which is less invasive?
Priya: Quick diff shows serializer returns None for missing keys. Probably easier to add a small guard in kv_cache for now to get CI green.
Sree: Can we rerun the CI after a fix? @ci-bot can you rerun the failing job (job id 6789) once we push?
ci-bot: Rerun scheduled by request (user: Sree). Will start when a new commit lands on the PR branch.
Alex: If Priya can open a patch, I'll review fast. Prefer minimal change: coerce Optional -> {} before update, and add a comment pointing to PR #4321 for follow-up.
Priya: I’ll open PR with this snippet: 
```py
# guard for new serializer Optional case (see PR #4321)
data = serializer.deserialize(key)
if data is None:
    data = {}
cache.update(data)
```
Priya: Also adding a unit test asserting serializer may return None and kv_cache still behaves.
Dan: Add a changelog note and link to the stricter mypy config change so this is discoverable.
Jamie: Sounds good. If CI still flakes after the fix, we should bisect the mypy upgrade commit. For now, small fix + test should unblock. :thumbsup:
Priya: Thanks all — will open PR and ping when CI rerun is queued.
Alex: Thanks — appreciate the quick coordination.
